references.text: Moses goes down from the mountain to the people to consecrate them, parallel to verse 25 where Moses again goes down to the people.
Moses goes down from the mountain with the tablets of the law, a similar action where Moses descends from Sinai to speak to the people.
Moses goes down from Mount Sinai with the tablets of the testimony, once again as mediator between God and Israel.
Moses recalls how the Lord spoke to him and told him to go quickly down from the mountain to the people.
God speaks the words that follow after Moses has gone down to the people, the introduction to the Ten Commandments.
The same event (Sinai) seen from different points in time; shows the continuity of Moses' mediation to the elders before the consecration of the people.
